Jonah — Finding PF1: The 900 kg scenic unit cannot be moved safely through the event space. The certified alternative is two separate 300 kg carts. This changes our scenic transport plan.

- Scenic transport will need to shift to the two 300 kg carts as the certified alternative.
- Participant group size must be capped at 8.
- Waivers must be signed by every participant.

Before I move to authorization, are there any other technical or compliance leads who need to submit a final finding?
